claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh deployed v0.15.169 Python browser evidence where the package blocked at 98/A because enriched slide decks averaged only 3.1 content-bearing slides.
Kernel/depth-marked slide decks now add deterministic concept-trace, boundary-check, transfer-check, and source-check teaching slides when the instructional body is thin.
The compiler-side guard counts teaching-body slides against lesson-title/key-concept vocabulary instead of crediting title, agenda, objective, bridge, or broad artifact words.
Deterministic content-floor slides preserve authored bullets and notes through the same passthrough path as existing kernel slides.
The release explicitly does not claim a fresh clean ZIP score; deployed v0.15.170 still needs a GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit.
